tasks.label: 编译 DokiDoki
args: $sdk = 'dotnet'; $installed = @(dotnet --list-sdks); if (-not ($installed -match '^10\.0\.')) { $localSdk = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'DokiDoki-sdk\dotnet.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $localSdk)) { throw 'Install the .NET 10 SDK and restart VS Code.' }; $sdk = $localSdk }; & $sdk build .\DokiDoki.csproj -c Debug; exit $LASTEXITCODE
